tasks.check:
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m py_compile derive_goalloop.py check_goalloop_graph.py || exit 1; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 check_goalloop_graph.py --draft pathway-goalloop-draft.json > final.txt 2>&1 || { echo 'FAIL: validator rejects derived graph:'; grep FAIL final.txt | head -5; exit 1; }; g=0; r=0; for f in fixture-conformant fixture-A-wait-self-loop fixture-B-negotiation-terminal fixture-C-banned-promise fixture-D-clock-containment fixture-E-duplicate-extraction; do if PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 check_goalloop_graph.py --draft $f.json >/dev/null 2>&1; then [ "$f" = fixture-conformant ] && g=1 || { echo "FAIL: gate weakened: $f"; exit 1; }; else [ "$f" = fixture-conformant ] && { echo 'FAIL: conformant rejected'; exit 1; } || r=$((r+1)); fi; done; [ "$g" -eq 1 ] && [ "$r" -eq 5 ] || { echo "FAIL: fixtures g=$g r=$r"; exit 1; }; PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 - <<'PY'
import json
work = json.load(open('/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workV93/build-v93/pathway-v93-draft.json'))
der = json.load(open('pathway-goalloop-draft.json'))
wm = {n['id']: json.dumps(n, sort_keys=True) for n in work['nodes']}
dm = {n['id']: json.dumps(n, sort_keys=True) for n in der['nodes']}
must_keep = ['n_identity', 'n_appt_check', 'e_defer', 'n_confirm', 'n_date_conflict', 'n_date_conflict_retry', 'n_help', 'n_office']
bad = [k for k in must_keep if k in dm and k in wm and wm[k] != dm[k]]
missing = [k for k in must_keep if k not in dm]
assert not missing, 'proven nodes missing from derivation: %s' % missing
assert not bad, 'proven nodes modified: %s' % bad
print('kept-verbatim proof OK for %d anchor nodes' % len(must_keep))
PY
rc=$?; [ $rc -eq 0 ] || { echo 'FAIL: kept-verbatim proof failed'; exit 1; }; grep -qiE 'fate|kept-verbatim' DERIVATION.md || { echo 'FAIL: no derivation table'; exit 1; }; echo 'PASS: derived graph validator-green, fixtures locked, anchor nodes byte-identical to production'
